hello.subtitle: Scaffold is up. The canvas comes next.

palette.title: Resources
palette.hint: Drag onto the canvas, or click to add

invalid.sameType: Two {{type}} don't reference each other. Connect resources of different types.
invalid.s3: An S3 bucket doesn't take this reference. Its access is modeled with IAM policies and roles.
invalid.instanceRole: An EC2 instance doesn't reference an IAM role directly; that goes through an aws_iam_instance_profile, which calco doesn't include yet.
invalid.lambdaVpc: A Lambda function joins a VPC through a vpc_config block (subnets and security groups together), not a loose connection. calco doesn't model that yet.
invalid.lbInstance: A load balancer doesn't point at an instance directly; targets live in an aws_lb_target_group, which calco doesn't include yet.
invalid.sgSource: A security group doesn't reference that resource. Instances, RDS, or load balancers reference it, not the other way around.
invalid.useContainment: To place {{child}} inside {{container}}, drag it into the box; that nesting creates the reference.
invalid.duplicate: These two resources are already connected.
invalid.noRule: There's no valid Terraform reference between these two resources.

hint.dropOnDot: Release on another resource's dot to connect them.
